svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · Shutter cluster · shoot running · portrait
svg.desc: Any shoot under way (isCapturing: video, interval, live blend, photo burst): the disc becomes the stop square and ALL FOUR toggles hide — the slots stay reserved but empty, so the cluster's footprint never changes. Interval runs and Photo bursts show exactly this; Video and Scanner runs put run-time controls in the bottom slots, see running.video and running.scanner.
